title: Germany 30-Year Bund multi-ISIN auction (EUR 2.5bn across two reopening lines) — the last 30Y date of 2026
source: EST: deutsche-finanzagentur.de English issuance calendar (/en/federal-securities/issuances/issuance-calendar), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 125,468 bytes) — the Quarter IV 2026 table lists TWO 30-year reopening lines dated 11.11.2026, 'Bund 30 Y (R)' at EUR 1.5bn and 'Bund 30 Y (R)' at EUR 1.0bn, both with ISIN, coupon and maturity shown as '-'. Corroborated by a second, independent Finanzagentur primary published months earlier: the H2 2026 issuance outlook workbook (Issuance_outlook_2026_Update_Q3_en.xlsx, HTTP 200, 78,201 bytes, 'As of June 2026'), whose row for 2026-11-11 reads 'Bund | 30 years | Reopenings (multi-ISIN) | 2500'. The dashes are expected: the auction-process page states that for 15- and 30-year multi-ISIN auctions the bonds 'are not finalised until the quarterly calendars are updated' and the second bond is 'only announced in a press notice in the week before the auction', four bank business days ahead — which for Wednesday 11.11.2026 falls on 2026-11-05. 11.11.2026 is a Wednesday, the day Germany auctions nominal Bunds of 7 years or more. Filed estimate on the same mechanical count as its proposer: market-events-data.ts defines no confirmed source prefix for a non-US sovereign debt office, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of bund-30y-auction-2026-10-14, 2026-09-09
notes: Discovered during the bund-30y-auction-2026-10-14 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09). It matters to that ledger for one reason beyond being the next like-for-like observation: it is the LAST 30-year auction date on the published 2026 calendar — Q4 carries 14.10 and 11.11 and no December date at all, which is what puts full-year 30Y auction-process supply at EUR 33.25bn against EUR 37.0bn in 2025 (-10.1%), the first down year since 2022. So 11.11 is the date on which FT-bund-30y-auction-2026-10-14-4's supply-plateau call either stands or is overtaken by a December addition. It is also the same EUR 2.5bn two-line shape, so it is the second out-of-sample observation for the allotment band (EUR 1,850-2,100m, hit by 21 of 23 identical-shape auctions since 2023) and for the measured spillover null (US 30Y CMT t = 0.01 across 213 dates). Adjacent to events this calendar already tracks: treasury-30y-bond-2026-11-12 falls the NEXT day, which is a tighter German/US super-long pairing than either the 09-16 or the 10-14 date had. Tiered `low` and NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED, for the same three reasons as its proposer: no house playbook is rates-keyed, no tracked symbol carries euro-rates exposure, and the spillover was tested twice and returned a null both times. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
